column3: With respect to the Mountain Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan (4.0%), specifically the 590 Northport Parkway Mortgaged Property, having an allocated loan amount of $55,817,422 or 3.4% of the related Whole Loan amount, Shaw Industries, Inc., the sole tenant and third largest tenant of the related portfolio of Mortgaged Properties, has free rent of $825,067, which was reserved for at origination.
